sources.title: 2026 Microsoft outage
sources.excerpt: A major global Microsoft outage started on 12 November 2026, with 140,000 people from 74 countries reporting issues on Downdetector by the evening of 12 November, covering numerous services including Microsoft 365, Outlook, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.
